decision.observation: No ladder was placed. A small dashed selection box and a Sandstone raw-mineral tooltip sit just left of the platform, over solid terrain. Three duplicants remain idle at the printing pod. Warnings persist.
decision.hypothesis: The ladder cannot be placed because no raw mineral has been mined; marking the reachable sandstone beside the platform with the Dig tool will yield raw mineral so a ladder can be built.
decision.memory: Ladder placement fails with Missing resources: Raw Mineral or Wood 100 kg, and drags over solid sandstone create selection boxes instead of blueprints. Copper ore dig site below is unreachable. Reachable sandstone borders the starting platform. Oxygen Diffuser needs 200 kg metal ore. Outhouse also required.
